scenes.en: Simple family rules for healthy young eyes.
scenes.say: Is the phone your child's babysitter? Here are simple family rules for healthy young eyes.

scenes.en: Close screens keep the eye's focusing muscle tight, and kids blink less.
scenes.ta: அருகில் நீண்ட நேரம் பார்த்தால் கண் சோர்வடையும்
scenes.say: When children stare at a screen up close for long, the focusing muscle inside the eye stays tight, and they blink less. That means tired, dry eyes.

scenes.en: Studies show daylight play outdoors lowers kids' risk of short sight.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show children who play outdoors in daylight are less likely to become short-sighted.

scenes.en: Screens at arm's length. 20-20-20 breaks. Screens off 1 hour before bed.
scenes.ta: திரையை கை நீள தூரத்தில் வையுங்கள். அடிக்கடி இடைவெளி
scenes.say: Do: keep screens at arm's length. Every twenty minutes, look at something far away for twenty seconds. And switch screens off an hour before bed.

scenes.en: Screens for babies and toddlers. Phones in a dark room. Screens at meals.
scenes.ta: இருட்டில் போன் வேண்டாம், சாப்பிடும்போது திரை வேண்டாம்
scenes.say: Don't: give screens to babies and toddlers, let kids use phones in a dark room, or keep screens on at meal times.

scenes.en: Family screen-free time: books, games, outdoor play.
scenes.say: Kids copy us. Make family screen-free time for books, games and outdoor play.

scenes.en: Squinting, sitting close to the TV, rubbing eyes, headaches
scenes.ta: கண் சுருக்குவது, டிவி அருகில் உட்காருவது: கண் பரிசோதனை செய்யுங்கள்
scenes.say: If your child squints, sits close to the TV, rubs their eyes, or gets headaches, book an eye test. Children often don't complain.
